r8_17_misreading.what: column / duct finish: R-13 ('the owner chose the full column') is about the full vs half deduction COLUMN of the historical blockwork SHEET - not structural columns. R8.17 cited it as column-face finish authority: a misreading (no value was published on it). The only column rule is owner_rules section E (skirting: 'a column is not an opening'). No rule states plaster / paint / tile on column faces or on the duct
r8_17_misreading.effect: no R8.17 value was published on it (PLASTER / PAINT were BLOCKED; WALL_TILE unpublished); corrected here: column faces UNRESOLVED in every trade
